ls3_final.goal: Run identical founder heredity through frozen contrasting physical environments and prove strong causal divergence without desired-biome or genome controls.

visualization.vis1: Godot spatial viewer with 32x32 world projection, camera, environment/population/biome overlays and selectable plants/cohorts.
visualization.vis2: Accepted procedural plant renderer driven directly by LS3.4 phenotype evidence; accepted head dd6304eb28434666a401f888b583d7b17c1474c5.
visualization.vis3: 2.5D physical Planet Patch viewer with hillshade/contours, biome boundaries, REGION/PATCH/PLANT LOD, bounded observed-generation history scrub and performance telemetry. History is presentation-only and never rewinds ecology.
visualization.vis2_authority: Presentation-only adapter + renderer; no phenotype recomputation, genome edits, fitness edits, persistence or network authority.
visualization.vis3_authority: Presentation-only terrain/history/telemetry over public Workbench facades; no ecology rewind, world write, persistence or network authority.

performance_debt.symptom: Later generations / larger populations become visibly CPU-heavy.
performance_debt.vis3_action: Measure Workbench step, VIS3 refresh, history capture, FPS, population and visible-plant count; REGION LOD suppresses individual plant geometry.
